author: Beverly Fryar
text: Loved this company, as the kept their appointment time & did a wonderful job with the job they were hired to do. Only reason for 4 instead of 5 stars is, they ran over our water meter box with their truck & completely destroyed it. We could see on our security cameras that he walked over to observe/evaluate the damage but failed to mention this to us before leaving. Accountability for the unintentional damage would have been preferred. Overall, still would use this company again & will recommend to others 👍

author: Courtney Lopez
text: Great service! They were prompt, courteous, and knowledgeable. We are also grateful for the troubleshooting and education Russell provided us when we needed it.

author: Vicki Cross
text: They came out @ drained the septic tank.  It took longer than expected but they did a great job!!

author: Lupe Munoz
text: Red Mr Fluornoys assistant came out today. I called & respectfully asked if they could work me in for my tank to be cleaned. They service is OUTSTANDING. I highly recommend this company over any other in Hill County or whatever other areas they service.

author: William Barnes
text: I cannot say enough good about these guys. Came right out and pumped my septic and had me up and going in no time at all. Very professional, courteous and thorough. Thank you Russell and Red! I highly recommend this company!
